levels.label: Tutorial 1
levels.name: Switch on
levels.hint: Wait for the portals to switch on, then walk through to the exit.

levels.label: Tutorial 2
levels.name: Pick the platform
levels.hint: The pink portal hops between three platforms. Look through the blue one and step in when you see the exit.

levels.label: Tutorial 3
levels.name: The gun
levels.hint: Grab the portal gun. Fire blue at a white pit wall, then walk through to come out of the pink portal up top.

levels.label: Tutorial 4
levels.name: Where are you going?
levels.hint: Blue goes where you are, pink is where you come out. Portals only stick to white walls.

levels.label: Tutorial 5
levels.name: Upgrade
levels.hint: Grab the pink upgrade. Now you place both ends: pink up by the exit, blue down here.

levels.label: Tutorial 6
levels.name: One of each
levels.hint: You only get one of each colour. Fire it again and it moves, so hop from room to room.

levels.label: BL 01
levels.name: Peek
levels.hint: The exit is somewhere else. Look through the portal to find it, then walk in.

levels.label: BL 02
levels.name: Find the angle
levels.hint: Something is hiding the white wall. Walk around until you can see it.

levels.label: BL 03
levels.name: One white panel
levels.hint: Portals only stick to white. Find the one white panel up by the exit.

levels.label: BL 04
levels.name: Over the glass
levels.hint: You can't shoot through glass, but you can shoot over it.

levels.label: BL 05
levels.name: Going up
levels.hint: Put your portal on the white floor and drop in.

levels.label: BL 06
levels.name: Sideways out
levels.hint: Drop in through the floor. You'll come out of a wall, facing the way to go.

levels.label: BL 07
levels.name: Behind you
levels.hint: Nothing in front of you takes a portal. Have a look around.

levels.label: BL 08
levels.name: Trapdoor
levels.hint: You're stuck in a pit. The only white is the floor under your feet.

levels.label: BL 09
levels.name: Shortcut
levels.hint: You could walk all the way round. Or you could make a portal.

levels.label: BL 10
levels.name: Big enough
levels.hint: A portal needs a white patch two blocks tall. Thin strips won't do.

levels.label: BL 11
levels.name: Over the gap
levels.hint: Too far to jump. Put a portal on the far wall instead.

levels.label: BL 12
levels.name: Either way
levels.hint: This time pink is next to you. Put blue up by the exit, then walk into pink.

levels.label: BL 13
levels.name: Weight
levels.hint: Put the box on the pad to open the door.

levels.label: BL 14
levels.name: Two pads
levels.hint: Every pad has to be pressed before the door opens.

levels.label: BL 15
levels.name: Fetch
levels.hint: The box is stuck in a room you can't walk into. Portal in, grab it, portal back.

levels.label: BL 16
levels.name: Post the box
levels.hint: The pad is in a tiny room behind glass. Send the box in through a portal.

levels.label: BL 17
levels.name: Order up
levels.hint: The box machine wakes up when you walk over to it.

levels.label: BL 18
levels.name: Catch from above
levels.hint: The box lands where you can't reach. Put a portal under it and let it fall to you.

levels.label: BL 19
levels.name: Cover to cover
levels.hint: The robot can't see through blocks. Dash from one to the next.

levels.label: BL 20
levels.name: Sneak up
levels.hint: Robots only look forwards. Creep up behind it and knock it over.

levels.label: BL 21
levels.name: Back door
levels.hint: Put a portal on the wall behind the robot and drop in behind it.

levels.label: BL 22
levels.name: Bowled over
levels.hint: Drop the box on the robot from up here.

levels.label: BL 23
levels.name: Just passing
levels.hint: Don't fight the robot. Portal straight past it.

levels.label: BL 24
levels.name: Quick step
levels.hint: Robots need a moment to aim. Don't stop in the corridor.

levels.label: BL 25
levels.name: All aboard
levels.hint: Ride the moving platform across.

levels.label: BL 26
levels.name: Hold to move
levels.hint: The platform only moves while its pad is pressed.

levels.label: BL 27
levels.name: Ride and look
levels.hint: Keep your eyes open on the ride. Something white only shows up halfway.

levels.label: BL 28
levels.name: Cargo
levels.hint: Take the box with you on the platform.

levels.label: BL 29
levels.name: First fling
levels.hint: Jump off the ledge into a floor portal. Falling fast makes you fly out fast.

levels.label: BL 30
levels.name: Upside down
levels.hint: Portals work on ceilings too.

levels.label: PI 01
levels.name: Two-step
levels.hint: You can't see the exit from here. Portal somewhere you can, then go again.

levels.label: PI 02
levels.name: Wait and return
levels.hint: The pink portal keeps moving. Grab the box and get back before it leaves.

levels.label: PI 03
levels.name: Stay back
levels.hint: Robots can only see so far. Make your portals from a safe distance.

levels.label: PI 04
levels.name: Catch the pink
levels.hint: Pink hops around. Put blue by you, then go when pink is up by the exit.

levels.label: PI 05
levels.name: Hold the door
levels.hint: Stand on the pad to open the door, and shoot a portal through before you step off.

levels.label: PI 06
levels.name: Chain reaction
levels.hint: You need two boxes. Going up on the balcony makes the second one drop.

levels.label: PI 07
levels.name: Relay
levels.hint: The box has to go two portal hops. Move your portals as you go.

levels.label: PI 08
levels.name: Courier
levels.hint: Carry the box into blue when pink shows the little room with the pad.

levels.label: PI 09
levels.name: Stack
levels.hint: The ledge is too high for one box. Try two.

levels.label: PI 10
levels.name: Box lift
levels.hint: Portals can lift things up too. Get the box up to the pad on the ledge.

levels.label: PI 11
levels.name: Bullseye
levels.hint: Drop the box out of the ceiling so it lands on the pad.

levels.label: PI 12
levels.name: Surprise behind the door
levels.hint: Opening the door lets the robot see out. Don't stand in the doorway.

levels.label: PI 13
levels.name: Crossfire
levels.hint: Two robots watch each other's backs. One of them is easier to reach first.

levels.label: PI 14
levels.name: Back for more
levels.hint: Two pads, two boxes, and they're both in the other room.

levels.label: PI 15
levels.name: From above
levels.hint: The robot is behind glass. Drop a box on it from the ceiling.

levels.label: PI 16
levels.name: Glass cover
levels.hint: The exit is past the robot. Hide behind the glass panes and dash between them.

levels.label: PI 17
levels.name: Snatch
levels.hint: The box drops right in front of the robot. Grab it with a portal instead of walking in.

levels.label: PI 18
levels.name: Portal climb
levels.hint: Go up and round, one shelf at a time. Each shelf shows you only the next.

levels.label: PI 19
levels.name: Blinking door
levels.hint: The door only opens while the platform sits on the pad. Be ready to run.

levels.label: PI 20
levels.name: Return trip
levels.hint: The box is on the far side. Ride over, grab it and ride back.

levels.label: PI 21
levels.name: Stop it there
levels.hint: Stand on the pad to move the platform. Step off when it's in the right place.

levels.label: PI 22
levels.name: Danger delivery
levels.hint: The pad is in the robot's view. Send the box in, not yourself.

levels.label: PI 23
levels.name: Mind the step
levels.hint: Pink is in the ceiling. Go through just as the platform passes underneath.

levels.label: PI 24
levels.name: Pick your drop
levels.hint: The higher you fall, the further you fly. Pick the right ledge to jump from.

levels.label: PI 25
levels.name: Launch pad
levels.hint: Pink is on the floor, facing up. Fall into blue to shoot up high, and steer onto the ledge.

levels.label: PI 26
levels.name: Box fling
levels.hint: Put blue on the pit floor, then drop the box into it from the ledge. Pink flings it onto the pad, which opens the door beside you.

levels.label: PI 27
levels.name: Carry-on
levels.hint: Fling the box left onto the pad. Then come back round, move pink to the right side, and fling yourself to the door.

levels.label: PI 28
levels.name: Fly past
levels.hint: Put blue on the pit floor and jump in from the ledge. Come in fast and the robot won't have time to aim.

levels.label: PI 29
levels.name: Low ceiling
levels.hint: Walk round to the far side of the wall and put pink about halfway up, then come back and fling. Too high hits the glass; too low falls short.

levels.label: PI 30
levels.name: Fling then shoot
levels.hint: Hop island to island with portals; the glass stops shortcuts. Ride the platform and shoot through the hole in the glass to reach the box, then carry it on to the pad.
